app.title: Lorewarden
app.tagline: Prepare your story, find the right thing at the table, react to your players.

englishTermsHint: Shows conditions and hit points in English and applies to new adventures (DC, Perception, hit points …).

settings.heading: Settings
settings.adventureLanguageHint: Applies to adventures you create yourself or with an AI assistant. For an existing adventure, change the language in its Adventure tab.
settings.dataDir: Adventures are kept in the folder {dir} on this computer.
settings.devVersion: Lorewarden, built from source. Update with git pull.
settings.howToUpdate: If you run Lorewarden with Docker Compose, update it on the server with:
settings.howToUpdateSource: If you run it from source, use git pull and pnpm start. Your adventures are kept.
settings.autoRollInitiative: Roll initiative for monsters and NPCs automatically
settings.autoRollInitiativeHint: Rolls d20 plus the initiative modifier from the stat block as soon as they are added, so you see the order before combat starts. Values you typed in stay. When this is off, monsters keep their initiative score (10 plus the modifier).
settings.shareInitiativeRolls: Monsters of the same kind share one roll
settings.shareInitiativeRollsHint: For example, all goblins of an encounter act on the same initiative. Goblins you add later join that roll.

common.inNoScene: Not placed in any scene yet.
common.notFound: This adventure does not exist (any more).
common.saveFailed: Your last change could not be saved. Check for empty required fields.

library.heading: Your adventures
library.localNote: Everything is stored on this computer, in the Lorewarden folder. Export an adventure to send it to someone or to move it to another computer.
library.empty: No adventures yet. Create one or load the example.
library.importHint: Load an adventure file exported from Lorewarden.
library.importFailed: This file could not be imported:
library.replaceConfirm: "{title}" already exists. OK replaces it, Cancel imports it as a copy.
library.deleteConfirm: Delete "{title}" and all its sessions? This cannot be undone.

adventure.title: Title
adventure.englishTerms: Rules terms in English (DC, Perception, hit points …)
adventure.summaryHint: Hook, antagonist, the truth behind it, the goal.

editor.noProblems: All references in this adventure are valid.

scenes.graphHint: Scenes are arranged by how many moves they are from the start. Click a scene to edit it.
scenes.title: Title
scenes.descriptionHint: What the players see and hear.
scenes.noNpcsYet: Create NPCs in the NPCs tab to place them here.
scenes.noItemsYet: Create loot in the Loot tab to place it here.
scenes.noExits: No exits. Mark the scene as an ending or add an exit.
scenes.addExitToNew: Add exit to a new scene
scenes.deleteConfirm: Delete the scene "{title}"? Exits leading to it are removed too.
scenes.noCluesYet: Create clues in the Clues tab to place them here.
scenes.noExitsEnding: No exits. The adventure can end here.
scenes.noMaps: An AI assistant draws a battle map for scenes with a fight when it creates the adventure. You can also upload a map image.
scenes.mapFailed: This file could not be read as an image.
scenes.noHandouts: Letters, notices, portraits or pictures of places that you can show on your players' phones in live mode.

npcs.name: Name
npcs.voiceHint: How you play them, e.g. deep and slow, a lisp, always says "my friend".
npcs.notesHint: What they know, what they want.
npcs.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It is removed from all scenes.

items.name: Name
items.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It is removed from all scenes.

live.newSessionConfirm: Start a new session? The log starts empty, player characters stay in the initiative list.

initiative.heading: Initiative
initiative.endConfirm: End the combat? Monsters and NPCs leave the list, player characters stay.
initiative.empty: Add the player characters once; they stay for the whole session.
initiative.name: Name
initiative.rollAllHint: Roll d20 plus the initiative modifier for monsters and NPCs. Values you typed in stay.
initiative.rollOneHint: Roll d20 plus the initiative modifier
initiative.startRollsHint: Monsters and NPCs that have not rolled yet roll now.

clues.hint: Truths the party should find out, as reminders for you, not text for the players. One truth per clue; you decide at the table how they learn it. Place each important clue in at least two scenes.
clues.textHint: The one truth the party finds out.
clues.notesHint: Ways to find it: a witness, a trace, an object.
clues.scenesHint: Pick every scene where the party can come across this clue.
clues.sceneCount: in no scene | in 1 scene | in {n} scenes

puzzles.hint: Riddles, locks and other puzzles. Show the puzzle and its hints on the players' phones in live mode.
puzzles.title: Title
puzzles.promptHint: The riddle, the inscription, the mechanism. Shown on the phones as it is.
puzzles.imageHint: A drawing or photo of the puzzle, shown together with the text. SVG drawings stay sharp at any size.
puzzles.imageDeleteConfirm: Remove the picture of this puzzle?
puzzles.hintsHint: From a gentle nudge to almost the answer. In live mode you show them one by one, to everyone or to some players.
puzzles.notesHint: Checks that help, what happens on a wrong answer, how the party gets on if they give up.

review.heading: Things to check before you play:
review.unreachableScene: “{name}” cannot be reached from the start scene.
review.deadEnd: “{name}” has no exits and is not marked as an ending.
review.noEnding: No scene is marked as an ending.
review.clueNowhere: The clue “{name}” is not placed in any scene.
review.clueInOneScene: The clue “{name}” can only be found in one scene. If the party misses it, the story may get stuck.
review.puzzleWithoutSolution: The puzzle “{name}” has no solution yet.
review.puzzleWithoutHints: The puzzle “{name}” has no hints. If the party gets stuck, you have nothing to help them with.
review.unusedNpc: {name} does not appear in any scene.
review.unusedItem: {name} is not placed in any scene.
review.encounterTooHard: The encounter in “{name}” is too hard for this party: {xp} XP, the budget for a high difficulty encounter is {budget} XP.
review.encounterDifficulty: The encounter in “{name}” says {stated} difficulty, but for this party its {xp} XP make it {actual}.

adapt.heading: Fit to your party
adapt.intro: Create a copy first if you want to keep the original, for example for another party size or level. The check above then shows which encounters no longer fit.
adapt.charactersHint: One line per character: name, class, background, what their player enjoys.
adapt.charactersNote: You can add the characters after the adventure is written. The AI then works them in.
adapt.aiHeading: Have it adapted by the AI
adapt.aiIntro: An AI assistant fits encounters and loot to this adventure's party ({size} characters, level {level}). If you entered characters, it also ties the start, clues and rewards to them. Plot and scenes stay.
adapt.replaceConfirm: Replace “{title}” with the adapted version? This cannot be undone.

claude.heading: Create with an AI assistant
claude.intro: Develop a new adventure step by step with an AI assistant such as Claude and import the result here.
claude.ideaHint: e.g. a haunted lighthouse, a heist at a wizard school…
claude.copied: Copied. Paste it into a new chat.
claude.step1: Paste the instructions into a new chat with the AI assistant.
claude.step2: Answer its questions, ideally also about your group's characters, and pick an idea. At the end it writes the adventure file.
claude.step3: Paste its last answer below and import it.
claude.answerHint: Paste the whole answer or just the JSON.
claude.importFailed: The adventure could not be imported. Give these errors to the AI and ask for a fixed file:
claude.languageNote: The adventure will be written in {language}.
claude.languageNoteTerms: The adventure will be written in {language}, with rules terms in English.

battleMap.title: Battle map
battleMap.deleteConfirm: Remove the battle map of this scene?

table.heading: Players
table.intro: Show handouts, images and hints on your players' phones. They join by scanning a QR code and need to be in the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
table.joinHint: Phones need to be in the same Wi-Fi as this computer. Scan the code with the phone's camera.
table.joinHintRemote: Scan the code with the phone's camera.
table.qrLabel: QR code to join the table
table.noNetwork: This computer is not connected to a local network. Join the Wi-Fi your players use.
table.newCodeConfirm: Create a new join code? Every phone has to scan the QR code again.
table.forgetConfirm: Remove {name} from the table? What was shown to {name} alone is taken back.

server.offline: The Lorewarden server is not running, so nothing can be loaded or saved. Start it with "pnpm start" in the Lorewarden folder; this page connects again on its own.

monsters.heading: Monsters
monsters.intro: Your own monsters with full stat blocks, next to the monsters of the SRD 5.2.1. Every adventure can use them, and the AI assistant knows them.
monsters.noOwn: No monsters of your own yet. Create one, copy an SRD monster or let the AI write one.
monsters.more: {count} more. Search to narrow the list.
monsters.none: Pick a monster or create a new one.
monsters.copyHint: The copy is yours to change, e.g. for a stronger variant with another name.
monsters.name: Name
monsters.savesHint: Leave a save empty if it is the ability modifier, and initiative if it is the Dexterity modifier.
monsters.notesHint: Tactics, looks, how to play it.
monsters.adventureHint: Stat blocks of the creatures this adventure invents. They travel with the adventure when you export it.
monsters.noneInAdventure: This adventure has no monsters of its own. Monsters from the SRD need no stat block here.
monsters.unused: Not used by any creature of the monster pool yet.
monsters.inUse: Still used by {names}. Change those creatures first.
monsters.replaceConfirm: Replace "{name}" in your monsters with this version?
monsters.savedToLibrary: Saved. Other adventures can use it now.

ai.heading: Write a monster with an AI assistant
ai.intro: Describe the creature, copy the instructions into a chat with an AI assistant such as Claude, and paste its answer here.
ai.ideaHint: e.g. a heron that steals the voices of sleepers, a goblin chieftain with a tamed boar…
ai.importFailed: The monster could not be imported. Give these errors to the AI and ask for a fixed stat block:

generator.heading: Encounters
generator.nothingFits: No combination of these monsters fits. Choose another type or difficulty.
generator.deleteConfirm: Remove this encounter from the adventure?

terms.source: From the SRD 5.2.1 (CC BY 4.0), only in English.

auth.heading: Password
auth.setUpText: Lorewarden asks for this password on every computer and phone you use it on, including the server itself. Use at least {min} characters.
auth.noPasswordText: Open the setup link that the server printed when it started, or open Lorewarden on the server itself. With Docker, "docker compose logs lorewarden" shows the link.
auth.noPasswordHint: Only needed if others can reach this Lorewarden, e.g. on a server. With a password, Lorewarden asks for it everywhere, on this computer too. Use at least {min} characters.
auth.changeHint: Changing the password signs out every other browser. Use at least {min} characters.
auth.fromEnvironment: The password is set with LOREWARDEN_PASSWORD on the server and can only be changed there.
auth.resetHint: Forgot the password? On the server, "lorewarden reset-password" removes it and prints a new setup link.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.tooShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.failed: The Lorewarden server could not be reached. Please try again.

connect.heading: Allow {app} to use Lorewarden?
connect.what: It can read, create, change and delete your adventures and sees what happens at the table in live mode, like the Lorewarden tools in an AI app on your computer.
connect.returnTo: Afterwards you go back to {host}. You can disconnect it in the settings at any time.
connect.needsPassword: Choose a password for Lorewarden in the settings first. Without one, nothing can connect from elsewhere.
connect.failedHeading: This connection request does not work
connect.failed: The link is incomplete, or the app is not known to Lorewarden. Start connecting again in the AI app.
connect.settingsHint: Add Lorewarden to Claude or another AI app as a custom connector with this address. The app then asks you to sign in here and to allow it.
connect.connected: No AI assistant is connected. | One AI assistant is connected. | {n} AI assistants are connected.
connect.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect every AI assistant? They have to be allowed again to use Lorewarden.
